text:
ella: @oncall-ops customer reports SSO failing immediately after our cert rotation — they get redirected to IdP, complete auth, then our ACS returns 502. They say browser shows a blank page and error in app logs: \"upstream response timeout\" but our saml logs show missing Assertion after decryption.

oncall-ops: can you paste the raw SAMLResponse (base64) or the decoded XML? need the exact payload to repro.

ella: pasting redacted (base64 decode):
```\n<samlp:Response ID=\"_abc123\" Version=\"2.0\" IssueInstant=\"2024-09-12T15:03:21Z\">\n  <saml:Issuer>https://idp.acme.example</saml:Issuer>\n  <!-- customer shows only EncryptedAssertion, no plain Assertion -->\n  <saml:EncryptedAssertion>...blob...</saml:EncryptedAssertion>\n</samlp:Response>\n```

marta: @ella did we change ACS path normalization during the rotation window? I vaguely remember a strict-acs check flip.

ella: we did flip strict ACS validation to close a path canonicalization edge. That shouldn't affect decryption though. My hunch: our saml-worker can't find the new private key alias after keystore refresh, so decryption returns nil -> later code tries to validate nil Assertion -> NPE -> 502.

raj: confirming logs: saml-worker shows stack: saml-processor.decrypt -> returns null -> validate.assertion -> java.lang.NullPointerException at AssertionValidator.java:87 -> results in 502 at edge. Also see keystore loader logs: \"imported cert alias=acme-signed-2024\" but our config still references alias \"acme-signing\". Keystore refresh code uses alias map and didn't pick alias by subjectDN fallback.

saml-bot: metadata-watcher: detected IdP metadata change for https://idp.acme.example/metadata.xml at 2024-09-12T14:58:07Z (signed). Fingerprint: SHA256:AA:BB:CC:...

ella: Customer confirms they rotated signing cert and updated metadata. We fetched new metadata and imported cert, but because alias name changed we didn't wire it up to the active key used for decryption.

marta: can you list repro steps so eng can reproduce locally? @raj

raj: repro (done locally):
1) curl -s https://idp.acme.example/metadata.xml -o idp.xml
2) extract cert -> openssl x509 -in idp.crt -outform PEM
3) keytool -importcert -alias acme-signed-2024 -file idp.crt -keystore idp.jks -storepass changeit
4) restart saml-worker (I used saml-worker:local with config pointing to idp.jks)
5) POST base64(SAMLResponse) to /sso/acs?tenant=acme -> observe 502; server log shows decrypt returned null and NPE.

ella: for immediate mitigation, can we temporarily enable alias fallback so any alias matching subjectDN is accepted? We can ask customer to delay rotation but they'd prefer not.

marta: risky to relax permanently. I'll open an eng PR to fix keystore loader to match by SubjectDN when alias not present and to log a clearer warning. In the short term we can flip SAML_KEY_ALIAS_FALLBACK=true (feature flag) on the affected cluster.

oncall-ops: created canary deploy with fallback flag enabled: deploy id deploy-2024-09-saml-key-fallback. Rolling canary now (5%). Monitoring health and SAML success rate.

saml-bot: deploy-bot: deploy-2024-09-saml-key-fallback -> canary PASS -> progressing to 100% in 6m.

ella: customer retried, now gets 200 and user created in app. Confirmed OK on their side :tada:. They reported their IdP sent only EncryptedAssertion (their config) which we now decrypt successfully.

raj: postmortem actions: add CI test for EncryptedAssertion-only flow; add metadata alias-change detection alert; update docs on key import alias best practices.

marta: filing INF ticket INF-2334 to track PR, CI test, rollback notes, and runbook updates. Assigning to eng-identity.

ella: thanks everyone — forwarding customer confirmation and steps to solutions. I'll attach sample logs and the deploy id.

oncall-ops: noted. Will keep watch for related metadata updates across tenants for 24h.

Participants: ella, raj, marta, saml-bot, oncall-ops
